hints.title: Long Division Remainder Tracking
hints.text: A fraction produces a repeating cycle if and only if a previous remainder reoccurs during elementary long division.

hints.title: Remainder to Position Association
hints.text: Record the string character index where each remainder first appears. When the same remainder recurs, insert opening and closing parentheses enclosing that cycle.

hints.title: Sign and Integral Extraction Procedure
hints.text: Extract the sign and whole integer part. If remainder is nonzero, append a period. In a loop, multiply remainder by 10, append the quotient digit, and store remainder indices until zero or repetition.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(D) time and O(D) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Floating point division loses precision and cannot identify exact recurrence cycles of arbitrary length.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking integer remainders requires at most D states, bounding time and memory linearly by the denominator.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle 64-bit integer overflow on INT_MIN and properly separate negative signs from the fractional part.
